english.title: Fail to comply with notice prohibiting implanting of microchips in cats or dogs - England
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed to comply with a notice served on **(..SPECIFY DATE OF NOTICE..) by the Secretary of State under regulation 10(2) of the Microchipping of Cats and Dogs (England) Regulations 2023, prohibiting you from implanting microchips in

(A)_[cats or dogs]_
(B)_[cats and dogs until you received further training on a course approved by the Secretary of State]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 10(2) and 14(2)(c) of the Microchipping of Cats and Dogs (England) Regulations 2023.
